race.comment: COL BURN (2) has returned in good order this prep and should be hitting his straps fourth-up. Inside draw should see him land cosy and be poised to strike when they sprint. TILL DUSK (7) sets up well for this fourth-up coming in off a win, and the form around her is red-hot. Keeps the claim and is in this up to her ears. TAM NA GHAR (12) didn't give her rivals a sniff at the Gold Coast when leading pillar-to-post. Gets a key switch in Thompson and will give them something to catch again, you'd assume. SNITZSTREAM (11) finished sixth over 1350m at Doomben last time out following a determined win two back. Will appreciate a drop in grade. Has claims.
